note: Article on the biometric national ID card and population register; it says nothing about taxpayers or a tax register.
Tax is named only as an administration that will exchange data; no taxpayer register is described.

facts.fact: The guide says the Guichet Unique automatically passes the registration file to the tax directorate (DGI), which assigns the taxpayer number (NIF) as a step of business creation.
Djibouti customs states that free-zone operators and forwarders enter their taxpayer number (NIF) in box 48 of IM7 and EX3 customs declarations in SYDONIAWorld.
